entries.text: Removed workarounds in `Basic` methods such as `xreplace`, `subs`, `replace`, `doit` and `sort_key` that tolerated non-`Basic` objects in `args`. Classes that put non-`Basic` objects in their `args` will now raise errors.
Fixed `reshape` in `sympy.codegen.fnodes` so that nested lists and tuples as arguments are converted to array constructors and work with `hash`, `sort_key` and `doit`.
Fixed `TensorHead` with `comm=None` so that it stores the commutation value as a SymPy `Integer` (`2`) instead of `None`.
